_comment: Per-character physical identity: ethnicity, build, features. Jeremy, 2026-10-01.
USE: injected into every GENERATION prompt (local shot plan, asset renders, eval
scenes) and available to the game persona/chat. NEVER written into a training
caption - these are identity traits; captioning one keeps it variable and the
LoRA never learns it. Make them VISIBLE in the images instead (fitted outfits
on 3/4 and waist-up frames). Folds into CharacterSource when a source.json exists.
`prompt` is the ready-made clause; keep it concrete (skin, hair, eyes, build) -
a heritage label alone steers Qwen weakly.

vivienne._note: The pink MUST be prompted. Measured 2026-10-04 by matched-seed A/B at epoch 21, three scenes, identical seeds - the only variable was this phrase: 'long black hair' gave black with a faint warm strand; DELETING the colour entirely also gave black, so the LoRA did not learn the pink on its own; 'long black hair with vivid pink underlights beneath the top layer' gave her real pattern. Identity cosine went UP, not down: 0.611 / 0.572 / 0.672. The earlier do_not_prompt note claimed naming it 'spreads pink everywhere' and that the LoRA would learn the placement from the photos - both are false, and acting on them cost a 90-render sweep that scored 0/90. Same shape as priya's glasses: a trait correctly absent from the CAPTIONS still has to be stated at RENDER time.
